import type { Register } from 'claude-code'

import { createContext } from './context'
import { dropFailedEntry, emptyBoxAfterQueue, queueTyped, rememberMarkdownFile, rememberToolOutput } from './features/capture'
import { asideFailed, completeAside, runAside, startSession } from './features/commands'
import {
  noteStepAnswer,
  onTurnEnd,
  onTurnStart,
  pausePlanFromTool,
  planToolFailed,
  savePlanFromTool,
  stepAnswerFailed,
  turnEndFailed,
  turnStartFailed,
  waitToolFailed,
} from './features/plan'
import { drawBand } from './ui/band'
import { drawListingFrame, drawPlanTool, hidePlanToolResult } from './ui/output'
import { drawPane } from './ui/pane'

// Every hook the plugin has, each handing its event to the module that does the work.
export const register: Register = (on, options) => {
  const ctx = createContext(options)

  on('session.start', ($, e, next) => startSession(ctx, $, e, next))

  on('prompt.submit', ($, e, next) => queueTyped(ctx, $, e, next)).catch(dropFailedEntry)
  // Beneath the one above, which drops a queued entry before it comes here: what the person
  // typed, at this terminal or through Remote Control.
  on('prompt.submit', { origin: { kind: /^(composer|bridge)$/ } }, ($, e, next) => noteStepAnswer(ctx, $, e, next)).catch(stepAnswerFailed)
  on('prompt.change', ($, e, next) => emptyBoxAfterQueue(ctx, $, e, next))
  on('prompt.autocomplete', ($, e, next) => completeAside(ctx, $, e, next))

  on('tool.call', ($, e, next) => rememberToolOutput(ctx, e, next))
  on('tool.call', { tool: 'Write' }, async ($, e, next) => rememberMarkdownFile($, e.file_path, await next(e)))
  on('tool.call', { tool: 'Edit' }, async ($, e, next) => rememberMarkdownFile($, e.file_path, await next(e)))
  // A RegExp: the laid types know only the tools connected when they were written, and the
  // plan tools' full names are known only once they are registered.
  on('tool.call', { tool: /__plan$/ }, ($, e, next) => savePlanFromTool(ctx, $, e, next)).catch(planToolFailed)
  on('tool.call', { tool: /__wait$/ }, ($, e, next) => pausePlanFromTool(ctx, $, e, next)).catch(waitToolFailed)

  on('turn.start', ($, e, next) => onTurnStart(ctx, $, e, next)).catch(turnStartFailed)
  on('turn.complete', ($, e, next) => onTurnEnd(ctx, $, e, next)).catch(turnEndFailed)

  on('command.run', { command: 'aside' }, ($, e) => runAside(ctx, $, e)).catch(asideFailed)

  on('ui.render', { component: 'AbovePrompt' }, ($, e, next) => drawBand(ctx, $, e, next))
  // LIST_PANE in ui/pane.tsx, written out so the engine's scan of this file reads it.
  on('ui.render', { component: 'Pane', requestId: 'aside' }, ($, e, next) => drawPane(ctx, $, e, next))
  on('ui.render', { component: 'CommandOutput' }, drawListingFrame)
  on('ui.render', { component: 'ToolUse' }, ($, e, next) => drawPlanTool(ctx, $, e, next))
  on('ui.render', { component: 'ToolResult' }, ($, e, next) => hidePlanToolResult(ctx, $, e, next))
}

{
  "name": "aside",
  "version": "0.31.0",
  "description": "A prompt queue for Claude Code. Queue prompts, ideas and comments while Claude works, without interrupting it, and send them once it finishes or whenever you are ready.",
  "author": {
    "name": "gravityXX",
    "url": "https://github.com/gravityXX"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/gravityXX/aside",
  "repository": "https://github.com/gravityXX/aside",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "prompt-queue",
    "message-queue",
    "queue",
    "backlog",
    "ideas",
    "comments",
    "clipboard",
    "workflow",
    "productivity"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "afterClaudeAnswers": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After Claude answers",
      "description": "What aside does by itself when Claude finishes answering and something is queued. wait: nothing, you run /aside. plan: what /aside plan does. run all: what /aside run all does, each entry a step of its own.",
      "default": "wait",
      "options": [
        "wait",
        "plan",
        "run all"
      ]
    },
    "planModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Model for /aside plan",
      "description": "session: Claude plans in this conversation, knowing the work so far, on the session's model. sonnet, haiku, opus: one call to that model plans outside the conversation; it adds nothing to the context and runs while Claude works, but sees only the queue.",
      "default": "session",
      "options": [
        "session",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku",
        "opus"
      ]
    },
    "newQueues": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "New named queues",
      "description": "Whom a named queue made by its first idea, as in +@work, is for. global: every project sees it. local: only the project it was made in. /aside q NAME local or global changes one later.",
      "default": "global",
      "options": [
        "global",
        "local"
      ]
    },
    "order": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Which entry comes first",
      "description": "oldest: first in, first out. newest: last in, first out. /aside lists, numbers and runs the queue in this order.",
      "default": "oldest",
      "options": [
        "oldest",
        "newest"
      ]
    },
    "tidy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tidy what you type",
      "description": "on: a small model fixes the spelling, punctuation and wording of each entry's own text, in its language, once it is queued. The copied quote is never changed or sent. off: entries stay as typed.",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
